rejects.name: reject-nan
rejects.note: Python json.dumps(float('nan')) emits 'NaN' (non-RFC); canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-non-string-key-int
rejects.note: Python coerces {1: 'a'} to '"1"'; canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-non-string-key-bool
rejects.note: Python coerces {True: 'a'} to '"true"'; canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-non-string-key-none
rejects.note: Python coerces {None: 'a'} to '"null"'; canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-duplicate-key
rejects.note: Python json.loads silently last-wins on duplicate keys; canonical writer raises DuplicateKey at parse time (strict loader).

rejects.name: reject-duplicate-key-multiple
rejects.note: Two pairs of duplicates; both flagged at parse time.

rejects.name: reject-unpaired-high-surrogate
rejects.note: Lone high surrogate U+D800 cannot encode as valid UTF-8 unless paired; canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-unpaired-low-surrogate
rejects.note: Lone low surrogate U+DC00 cannot encode as valid UTF-8 unless paired; canonical writer rejects.

rejects.name: reject-unsupported-bytes
rejects.note: bytes is not JSON-encodable; Python and canonical writer both reject.

rejects.name: reject-unsupported-set
rejects.note: set is not JSON-encodable; Python and canonical writer both reject.
